item.tib: zab lam gsang ba sngags kyi spyi spungs gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i phyag bzhes 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni 7mchog spal rin po che yis bka' gnang ji phab la gyen ldog ma nus bka' lung gtsor bzhag cing / rang gis bsam bya la gzhig 'brel legs par btang ste/ spyan 'bebs yang yang phul zhing bsgrigs pa po ni a 'thas pa shes rab ming gis/ bsgrang (bgrang) bya bdun cu don gsum lon skabs/ gcol gtam cal col dang bcas te/ gnam lo stod 'grel bod skad du 'dzin byed zhes dbang thang dang bstun pa'i me pho byi ba'i lor/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes 13nyin par dben gnas dga' ri khrod du bgyis pa 'dis kyang mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas shing*/ 'gro kun gsang sems nyung (zung) 'jug rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung nas shar/ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma'i sku tshe ni/ bskal brgya'i bar du rtag brtan bzhugs pa dang / 'gro kun bde skyid yun ring 'byung gyur cig/
